text: The three rotations are load-bearing: 1 call agrees 103/111=92.8 pct, fixed 2-call 105/111=94.6, only the 3-call mean reaches 106/111=95.5 vs the CLI mean. Any rotation cut flips the keep rule to keep-cli.

Early stop (2 calls when orders 0+1 agree) spends 228 vs 333 calls but lands at 105/111=94.6 pct - the saved third call is exactly the call carrying the lost row. The 3rd rotation is the price of the verdict.
Same-rotation agreement is order 0: 95.5 pct, order 1: 93.7, order 2: 96.4; per-order total 317/333=95.2. Position effects move individual answers on both sides; no single rotation is safely best.

Margin-gated escalation is the one agreement-raising policy on record: deferring 7 rows with Pi top-2 mean margin under 0.10 to the CLI gives 110/111=99.1 pct while Pi answers 104/111; a 0.05 gate defers 2 rows and gives 96.4. All five disagreements sit inside the sub-0.10 margin pool.

Catalog prices (USD per 1M input tokens, output 0): typesafe/jev-1.13 .042; ~typesafe/jev-latest .042; jaredpalmer/kev-4b .042; respan/span-01 .02; respan/span-01-lite and :free 0; upstage/solar-decide .05; opencode/jev-1.13-free 0 but Zen credential absent. span-01-lite:free is the only currently available zero-cost arm.

At .042/M the recorded cost_per_100=0.0022399 implies about 533 input tokens per call and about $0.0075 for the full 333-call replay; the free arm would save under a cent per replay and has no keep-rule run.

The dominant cost is wall time: 333 sequential calls in about 1 min 29 s with Pi mean 260 ms; codemode runs up to four classifier calls at a time per script, so a codemode-routed batch replay could cut wall time roughly 4x, while the SDK path stays sequential.

Input shapes differ: the CLI receives the raw prompt on stdin while Pi receives state:{request: prompt}; state_sha12 proves only what Pi sent. A shape-matched retry is a cheap untested accuracy experiment.

No documented sampling control exists: classify() receives {signal} only and the three documented surfaces expose no temperature or seed, so rotation averaging is the only variance control the transport has.

Two of the five disagreements are metric artifacts (rr-iter3-127 crossed means with identical order picks; rr-iter3-125 exact CLI tie settled by option order), so part of any reported accuracy lift is metric repair, not model behavior - carried to the trustworthiness iteration.
Direct TypeSafe jev-latest reports tokens at no cost but needs TYPESAFE_API_KEY (absent); opencode/jev-1.13-free needs an OpenCode Zen credential while the installed OpenCode credential is Go.
